title: Slow English Podcast #39: Rent a Car

sentences.text: Renting a car is something many people do when they travel or need a car for a short time.
Part one, important words related to renting a car.
I will say each word slowly and you can repeat after me.
Car rental, a service where you can rent a car for a short period of time.
Rental agency, a company that rents cars.
Driver's license, a document that allows you to drive a car.
Insurance, protection in case of an accident or damage to the car.
Deposit, money you pay in advance when renting the car, often for security.
Fuel, the gas or petrol that powers the car.
Mileage, the number of miles or kilometers the car has been driven.
Model, the type or brand of the car.
Pick up location, the place where you get the car.
Drop off location, the place where you return the car.
One way rental, when you pick up the car at one location and drop it off at another.
Part two, useful phrases when renting a car.
Now let's learn some useful phrases you can use when you are renting a car.
I will say each phrase twice.
Listen carefully and repeat after me.
I would like to rent a car.
Can I see the available cars?
How much is the daily rental rate?
Is there an extra charge for insurance?
Do I need to pay a deposit?
What's the fuel policy?
Can I pick up the car here and drop it off at another location?
Is the car available for one day, one week?
How old do I need to be to rent a car?
Do I need an international driver's license?
Part three, describing the type of car you want.
Let's talk about how to describe the type of car you want to rent.
Here are some sentences you can practice.
I want a small car.
I need a car with automatic transmission.
I would like a car with air conditioning.
I'm looking for a car with a GPS system.
I prefer a four -door car.
I need a car that can fit four people and luggage.
I would like a luxury car.
I want a convertible.
Part four, questions you can ask about the car.
It's important to know what questions to ask when you are renting a car.
Here are some common questions you can ask.
Is the car available for the dates I need?
How many miles does the car have?
Is the car fully insured?
What's the fuel policy?
Do I need to return it full?
Does the car have a navigation system?
Is there a limit to how many miles I can drive?
Are there any additional fees or taxes?
Can I get a child seat with the car?
Is the car clean and in good condition?
Part five, common situations when renting a car.
Let's talk about some situations you might experience when renting a car.
I will describe each situation and give you some useful sentences to practice.
Arriving at the car rental agency.
Hello, I have a reservation for a car.
I would like to rent a car for X days.
Can I see the available cars?
Asking about the price.
How much does the rental cost per day week?
Is there an extra charge for additional drivers?
Do I need to pay for insurance?
Before you leave the rental agency, can I see the car before I sign the contract?
Is the car in good condition?
Do I need to fill up the tank before I return it?
Part six, common problems when renting a car.
Sometimes there can be problems when renting a car.
Let's look at some common problems and how to talk about them.
The car is not what I expected.
This car is too small for my luggage.
I asked for a GPS system, but this car doesn't have one.
The car is damaged.
There's a scratch on the car?
I didn't do it.
The car has a dent.
How do we fix this?
I don't understand the rental agreement.
Can you explain the terms of the lease?
What's included in the price?
Are there any hidden fees?
Great job.
Let's review everything we've learned today.
Important words.
Rental agency, insurance, deposit, fuel, mileage, model, pickup location, drop -off location.
Useful phrases.
I would like to rent a car.
How much is the daily rental rate?
Can I pick up the car here and drop it off somewhere else?
Describing the type of car.
I want a small car.
I need a car with automatic transmission.
I would like a car with air conditioning.
Questions to ask.
How many miles does the car have?
Is there a GPS system in the car?
What's the fuel policy?
Common situations.
Arriving at the rental agency.
Asking about the price.
Checking the car condition.
Common problems.
The car is not what I expected.
The car is damaged.
I don't understand the rental agreement.
Now try to practice these sentences.
Imagine you are renting a car for a trip.
You can listen to this episode again to improve your pronunciation and confidence.
Thank you for listening to Slow English Podcast.
